title: Sales staff and manager interactions
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly mention interactions with sales staff or managers, with positive examples highlighting helpful, friendly, and competent support while many other fragments are too context-limited to classify.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise sales staff and managers for being helpful, friendly, competent, and effective at explaining pricing or lease details.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention sales staff or managers in passing or provide too little context to reliably judge whether the interaction was good or bad.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are brief or incomplete, so sentiment is often unclear.
Some examples include praise-like wording but are assigned undetermined, so the summary follows the supplied sentiment labels rather than reclassifying them.
The topic groups several kinds of sales-related mentions, from compliments to factual references and follow-up requests, which limits how specific the overall pattern can be.
